title: Tsutaya Bookstore in Shenzhen
description: Shangxuan loves books and is obsessed with his college life by exploring every bookstore in Shenzhen. He was fascinated by the largest Tsutaya Bookstore in southern China. This video remarks on his thoughts about books and the philosophy of life.
